'''Alex Alcalde Wizards!!!''' is a [[Young Jedi]] Jedi list published on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site. [[Alex Alcalde]] posted it as '''Gold 31'''.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alex Alcalde]]
* '''Published:''' by 9 July 2000 (Corellian Engineering Corporation)
* '''Format:''' [[Young Jedi]]
* '''Side:''' Jedi
* '''Strategy:''' Wizards!!!
